reference_policy: No expected Fields, SQL, row order, guard classifications or exact Spark cause/stage details were changed. Every unknown case remains an independent observation.
input_map_order: Declared provider rows and observed_rows_raw are both retained in the captured header. native_api_boundaries.resolve: plan_query parses/analyzes/resolves into SparkSqlQuery before session analyzer/optimizer.
native_api_boundaries.create_physical_plan: SparkSqlQuery::create_physical_plan invokes DataFrame::create_physical_plan, which includes session analysis, optimization and physical preparation. This is an observed API boundary, not an inferred internal failure stage.
native_api_boundaries.collect: collect executes the prepared physical plan.
native_api_boundaries.separate_optimizer: capture_spark_optimized_observation resolves the SQL again before independently attempting session optimization. It records raw schema/name checks or a raw error, but does not expose a separate failure-phase tag. An optimized_error value alone does not establish that the optimizer ran; use the main native API phase and retained error for inspection.

observer_policy: Temporary diagnostic target invoked explicitly by root, not an acceptance test. It emits one full JSON record per case and batch plus native before/after guards. Successful exit validates fixture/harness completeness only. Raw observations are authoritative even when diagnostic_mismatch_fields omits a top-level matches=false. Summary counts and generic error booleans never establish compatibility. Matching native JSON containing observer_error or panic is an infrastructure result requiring review, not proved native behavior; no guard acceptance is claimed. All raw reference/native causes/phases, helper errors and panics remain visible.
limitations: Only source/fixture preparation and static integrity checks were performed here; root must compile/run the observer.

The unchanged archived capture script/cases preserve original absolute source-dependency paths. Frozen copies of those dependencies are included under sources for provenance; no portability rewrite was made. The Rust observer consumes the reference fixture and needs no Spark/JVM.

Shared native capture helper sorts its native-control row comparison copy and does not capture native optimized schema or raw pre-sort native rows. Spark-case observations retain rows_raw and all public/optimized/pre/post-physical Fields. Native control SQL is explicitly ordered where successful; do not claim native raw row order from that sorted helper.

Shared Spark helper condition-token error flags are diagnostic. Exact raw error causes, optimized errors and API phases remain visible for root adjudication; the existing exact Int32 cast-input check is emitted separately.
Grouped queries can fail or reveal duplicate generated-column gaps before later fields execute. They are retained unchanged; any isolating probe must be a separately recorded addition.

Native before_matches/after_matches compare raw JSON as diagnostics. Identical observer_error/panic JSON does not prove a native guard passed; those records require infrastructure review before any behavior claim. The diagnostic summary may omit a top-level matches=false, so audit every raw object rather than promoting summary counts to acceptance.

output_records.error_review: Always explicit when Spark expects an error or DAR reports one; generic condition checks are not exact cause acceptance.
